scope: Abstract Boolean equations and observed relation samples only; no game boards, scalar games, or sealed outcomes computed

sourceSplit.preserves: Four projected edges S-B-T and S-C-T, their labels/deltas and one Boolean value per refined node; only source endpoint occurrences are split
sourceSplit.limitation: Countermodel to unguarded endpoint-occurrence refinement prose. It is not a countermodel to the native fixed-source guard, and does not assert a physically realizable full-game/source lift; those stronger premises are absent from the claimed universal prose.

relativeParity.conclusion: Observed x!=y disproves y=x and every group homomorphism Z2->Z2 (which must map 0 to 0), but permits an arbitrary function with f(0)=1 and does not alone disprove y=f(x). A second same-input/different-output sample is required for arbitrary non-factorization.
relativeParity.premiseAudit: SC-IA057 lists only SC-IA056, whose body is the observed parity pair. Neither that body nor the SC-IA057 scope specifies homomorphism-only candidate functions.
relativeParity.possibleRepair: Explicitly admit diagonal route-pairs with relative parity 0 and phase difference 0, or restrict the assertion to inequality/direct-parity/homomorphism-law falsification. The original sole premise does not state that enlarged comparison domain.

enlargedAllRoutePairs.conclusion: Including diagonal pairs gives a genuine same-input/different-output witness, hence arbitrary relative-parity factorization fails on all route pairs. The singleton f(0)=1 countermodel does NOT fit this enlarged domain.
enlargedAllRoutePairs.nativePremiseAudit: The inspected kernel binds route A and B separately and defines the single transporter 197502 as composition of 197500 and 197501. It does not declare a general route-pair-to-relative-transporter/difference relation including diagonals; SC-IA057 sole premise is the fixed-pair SC-IA056 observation. General finite-map closure can supply the missing elementary derivation, but it is not the stated proof/body.
